scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.serve: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run serve --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test --workspace frontend && npm run test --workspace backend && npm run build
